plan: Comprehensive design delivered in single document with all 10 required sections: (1) Objective & H₀/H₁ with decision rule; (2) Data sources — stratified panel of 20 tetrapeptides (covers all 20 AAs via X=representative) with pipeline-agnostic I/O contract for npy/dcd/xtc; (3) CV definitions (φ/ψ/ω + χ) with periodic wrapping and angular-embedding for TICA; (4) Per-family metrics — backbone (Ramachandran KDE overlap, circular-Wasserstein, basin pop), sidechain (rotamer pop TV + circular-Wass), TICA (top-k, lag sweep 0.2/1/5 ns, MMD² multi-σ + 1D-Wass + KDE overlap); (5) 7 controls C-a through C-g; (6) Block bootstrap CIs (n≥1000, default 2000), BH-FDR q=0.05 within family, permutation p for MMD, pre-specified effect-size equivalence thresholds; (7) Primary stack (mdtraj/scikit-learn/PyEMMA/deeptime) plus pure-numpy/scipy fallback with explicit algorithm specs (TICA via generalized eigenproblem, von Mises KDE, linear-time MMD); (8) Feasibility — 3–7 min/sequence serial; ~5–15 min wall on 24-core CPU for full panel × 3 lags; (9) Risk table + sensitivity plan; (10) Deliverables — design.md, algorithms.md (with signatures), io_contract.json schema, expected-output table skeleton, code repository structure. सभी assumptions (A1–A10) और unresolved uncertainties documented at the end।

context.question: Do the sampled trajectories from the forward simulation model exhibit distributional similarity to ground-truth MD trajectories across key collective variables, such as backbone torsions, sidechain torsions, and top TICA components?
context.context: Design an experiment that answers the question. The researcher can clarify source-supported setup details by topic. Do not claim that an experiment was run.

environment.software_environment: system Python; project dependencies not preinstalled
environment.note: Successful exploratory commands are not proof of a completed experiment.
